evals.prompt: We ran a Nova evaluation recipe as a SageMaker job against our fine-tuned model and it failed, and I also want to know whether we even evaluated the model before we promoted it. Can you review the SageMaker-side evaluation?
evals.expected_output: A read-only review that first confirms the request is SageMaker-side (a Nova eval recipe or LLM-as-judge run as a SageMaker job) and would hand a Bedrock-native CreateEvaluationJob off to llmops-quality-evaluation (LLM-SM-EVAL-004) rather than diagnosing it here. It reads the eval job status and FailureReason for a bad eval-dataset path, a malformed recipe, or a judge-model access error (LLM-SM-EVAL-002), checks whether the customized artifact was promoted with no eval run at all (LLM-SM-EVAL-001), and whether eval output was published and retained for run-over-run comparison (LLM-SM-EVAL-003). It cites LLM-SM-EVAL check-ids, gives each remediation as a command for the operator to run without mutating anything, and redacts the account id.
assertions: The response confirms the evaluation is SageMaker-side and routes a Bedrock-native CreateEvaluationJob to llmops-quality-evaluation rather than diagnosing it here
The response reads the eval job status and FailureReason rather than guessing the cause of the failure
The response checks whether the artifact was evaluated before promotion and whether eval output is retained for comparison
The response cites an evaluation sub-family check-id and gives the remediation as a command for the operator to run rather than mutating any resource

assertions.text: At least one finding carries an LLM-SM evaluation check-id
No raw 12-digit account ID is exposed
